definition.en: Multidimensional Poverty refers to the deprivation of essential human needs beyond just income, encompassing health, education, and standard of living.
definition.hi: Multidimensional Poverty refers to the deprivation of essential human needs beyond just income, encompassing health, education, and standard of living.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is critical for UPSC GS-3 as it provides a holistic framework for evaluating inclusive growth and social justice in the Indian economy. It is frequently used in Mains answers to discuss NITI Aayog's policy interventions and the effectiveness of welfare schemes.
importanceInUpsc.hi: This topic is critical for UPSC GS-3 as it provides a holistic framework for evaluating inclusive growth and social justice in the Indian economy. It is frequently used in Mains answers to discuss NITI Aayog's policy interventions and the effectiveness of welfare schemes.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the shift from income-based to multidimensional poverty measurement.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the shift from income-based to multidimensional poverty measurement.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of NITI Aayog in tracking poverty indicators in India.
